meta.title: SokhaPheap — Know your health risk
meta.description: Check your diabetes and heart disease risk, understand your blood test, and find a health facility near you.

common.disclaimer: This is not a diagnosis. Please consult a doctor.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.demoBanner: Demo mode — answers are pre-filled and nothing is saved.

home.tagline: Know your health risk early, and find care near you.
home.checkRiskHint: Diabetes and heart disease · about 3 minutes
home.explainLabHint: Take a photo of your blood test and we'll explain it simply
home.findCareHint: Hospitals, health centres and clinics near you
home.privacy: We don't store your name, phone number or photos.

urgent.title: First, a safety check
urgent.question: Do you have any of these right now?
urgent.fainting: Fainting, or feeling like you will faint
urgent.highSugar: Very high blood sugar signs: extreme thirst, passing a lot of urine, confusion or very sleepy
urgent.goNowBody: These symptoms can be serious and need care today. Go to the nearest hospital now, or ask someone to take you. Do not drive yourself.
urgent.continue: I am safe, continue the risk check

risk.title: Risk check

sex.q: Are you a man or a woman?

age.help: This check is for adults 18 and older.

height.help: If you don't know, stand against a wall, mark the top of your head, and measure from the floor.

weight.help: Use a scale at home, a pharmacy or a health centre.

waist.help: Use a string: wrap it around your belly at the level of your belly button, breathe out normally, mark the string, then measure it with a ruler or tape. You can also use your trouser waist size as a rough guide.

activity.q: Do you do at least 30 minutes of physical activity every day?
activity.help: This includes physical work, walking, cycling, farming or exercise.

vegFruit.q: Do you eat vegetables or fruit every day?

bpMeds.q: Have you ever taken medicine for high blood pressure?

highGlucose.q: Has a health worker ever told you that your blood sugar was high?
highGlucose.help: For example at a check-up, while you were sick, or during pregnancy.

family.q: Has anyone in your family had diabetes?
family.second: Yes: grandparent, aunt, uncle or cousin
family.first: Yes: parent, brother, sister or my own child

smoker.help: Cigarettes, hand-rolled tobacco or other smoked tobacco.

sbp.q: Do you know your blood pressure?
sbp.help: Blood pressure is written like 130/80. Enter the top (bigger) number from a recent measurement.

province.q: Which province do you live in?
province.help: Optional. Used only for anonymous statistics.

cvdUnavailable.bmi_unknown: We need your height and weight to estimate your heart risk.

factors.diet: Not eating vegetables or fruit every day
factors.high_glucose_history: High blood sugar in the past

results.noFactors: No major risk factors from your answers.

lab.title: Explain my blood test
lab.intro: Take a clear photo of your blood test report. We read the numbers, check them against normal ranges, and explain them simply.
lab.privacyNote: Your photo is not saved. It is deleted as soon as the numbers are read.
lab.photoTips: Tips: put the report on a flat table, use good light, and keep the whole table of results in the photo.
lab.confirmIntro: Please check that we read your report correctly. Fix any mistakes before continuing.

reasons.low_confidence: The photo was not clear enough to read this.
reasons.unknown_test: We don't check this test yet.
reasons.no_reference_range: No normal range printed on the report for this test.

lab.nothingFound: We could not find any test results in this photo. Try another photo, or type the numbers yourself.
lab.aiUnavailable: Photo reading is not available right now. You can type the numbers yourself.

nextSteps.lab_follow_up: Show this report to a doctor, especially the results outside the range.
nextSteps.lab_all_normal: Keep this report and show it at your next check-up.

templates.allNormalLine: The results we could check are within the range.

about.title: About SokhaPheap
about.body: SokhaPheap helps adults in Cambodia understand their risk of type 2 diabetes and heart disease early, explains blood test results in simple language, and shows the nearest health facilities using Cambodian open data. It was built for the Open Data × AI Venture Hackathon, Phnom Penh, 2026.
about.how1: Diabetes risk uses the FINDRISC questionnaire (Finnish Diabetes Risk Score).
about.how2: Heart risk uses the WHO 2019 non-laboratory cardiovascular risk chart for South-East Asia.
about.how3: Scores are calculated by fixed rules, not by AI. AI is only used to read lab report photos and to explain results in simple words.
about.limit1: These scores were developed outside Cambodia and have not been validated in Cambodia yet.
about.limit2: Part of the facility data is from 2010. Some facilities may have moved, closed or changed.
about.limit3: Lab normal ranges vary between laboratories. We use the range printed on your report when there is one.
about.privacy: We do not ask for or store your name, phone number or ID. Lab photos are deleted right after reading. Risk results are saved without any personal details, for anonymous statistics.

bot.welcome: Hello! I am the SokhaPheap bot. I can check your diabetes and heart disease risk, explain your blood test, and find health facilities near you.
bot.help:
Commands:
/check – start a risk check
/lab – explain a blood test photo
/near – find health facilities near you
/remind – get a reminder to check again
/language – change language
/help – show this message
bot.sendLocationPrompt: Tap the button below to share your location, and I will find the nearest health facilities.
bot.sendNumber: Please type a number between {min} and {max}.
bot.typeAge: How old are you? Type a number, e.g. 45.
bot.typeHeight: How tall are you in cm? e.g. 160
bot.typeWeight: How much do you weigh in kg? e.g. 60
bot.typeWaist: What is your waist size in cm? Use a string around your belly at the belly button. Type a number, or tap "I don't know".
bot.typeSbp: Do you know your blood pressure? Type the top number (e.g. 130), or tap "I don't know".
bot.labPrompt: Send me a clear photo of your blood test report. Your photo is not saved.
bot.labConfirm: I read these results. Are they correct?
bot.labWrongHelp: Sorry. Please use the website to correct the numbers, or send a clearer photo.
bot.remindPrompt: When should I remind you to check again?
bot.remindSaved: Done. I will remind you on {date}. Send /stopremind to cancel.
bot.reminderMessage: Hello from SokhaPheap! It is time to check your health risk again. Send /check to start.
bot.notUnderstood: Sorry, I didn't understand. Send /help to see what I can do.
bot.urgentQ: First, do you have chest pain, fainting, or signs of very high blood sugar (extreme thirst, lots of urine, confusion) right now?
bot.urgentYes: Yes, I have one of these
